newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Chemical hit by several factors.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Chemical hit by several factors.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp said Tuesday soft market demand, intense competition and higher costs combined to limit its earnings and sales in the first quarter ended March 31.

The specialty chemical manufacturer posted net income of $52.9 million, or $0.87 a share, versus $66.2 million, or $1.03, in the same period last year. Net sales fell to 493.5 million from 537.0 million a year ago, the company said.
Great Lakes said its specialty chemicals business showed noteworthy improvement from the previous quarter and its petroleum additives business continued to provide significant earnings and cash flow.
Great Lakes shares were off 1 Tuesday at 43.
